scenicChapters.title: Estrada da Graciosa
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 21 km this is Estrada da Graciosa, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-pico-do-marumbi-state-park-guarag.story: From Piraquara it runs 144 km to Piraquara; allow about 2 h 29 of riding. It goes by way of Zone & State Park Pau Oco Turistical Prese, Guaraguacu Ecological Station and back through Zone & State Park Pau Oco Turistical Prese. The line favours views over speed.
